latestVersion.changelog:
v1.0.0 (summary: Major upgrade with cross-session sync and rebranding)

- Rebranded the skill as "learn-from-experience"
- Added a cross-session memory sync protocol: confirmed learnings are compiled to the agent’s global config for automatic persistence and loading in new sessions
- Introduced multi-agent compatibility (Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, CodeBuddy, opencode)
- Updated architecture to store memory in a shared location (`~/learn-from-experience/`) structured by hot, warm, and cold tiers
- Expanded documentation with guidelines, learning signals, and troubleshooting for robust self-learning across all supported agents
